description: This file contains shell functions for platform upgrade procedures specific to certain hardware platforms, including image checks, configuration copying, and upgrade execution based on board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is valid for the specific platform based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration for the specific platform based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure for the specific platform based on board name.
